title: Silent Payments Output Descriptors
description:
Silent Payments, Output Descriptors - niftynei

Craig Raw has proposed a new BIP for how to express silent payments as output descriptors. This is a report on the new BIP and what silent payments are.

Recorded at POPOP in Taipei, Taiwan during bitcoin++ sovereignty edition.
Full agenda at https://btcpp.dev/conf/taipei#agenda
